greet.speaker: Lola Pacita
greet.line: Apo! Nakarating ka na. Pumasok ka na, maaliwalas ang bahay.
greet.line_en: Child! You're here. Come in, the house is calm.

offer_food.speaker: Lola Pacita
offer_food.line: May nagluto na akong adobong manok at kanin. Kain muna tayo mamaya, 'wag ka magpapagutom.
offer_food.line_en: I made chicken adobo and rice. We'll eat later. Don't go hungry.

ask_choice.speaker: Apo
ask_choice.line: Salamat, Lola. Ang tagal ko nang hindi nakakapunta rito. May itatanong sana ako...
ask_choice.line_en: Thank you, Lola. It's been so long since I've visited. I was hoping to ask something...

choices.text: Kanino 'yung mga lumang litrato sa pader?
choices.text_en: Who's in the old photos on the wall?
Is there an old room here?

about_lolo.speaker: Lola Pacita
about_lolo.line: Nasa dining room si Lolo mo. Kaunting malamig na siya kay sa dati. Puro bintana lang tinitingnan.
about_lolo.line_en: Your Lolo is in the dining room. He's a little quieter now than before. He just looks out the window.

about_photos.speaker: Lola Pacita
about_photos.line: Pamilya natin lahat 'yan. 'Wag mo na masyado tingnan — iniligpit ko na dapat 'yun. Mga lumang araw na.
about_photos.line_en: That's all our family. Don't look too closely — I should have put those away. Old days.

about_room.speaker: Lola Pacita
about_room.line: Pakinggan mo ako, apo. May isang silid dito sa tabi ng pasilyo. Nakakandado. 'Wag mong buksan. Pangako mo sa akin.
about_room.line_en: Listen to me, apo. There is a room by the hallway. It is locked. Do not open it. Promise me.

flashlight.speaker: Lola Pacita
flashlight.line: Dito, kunin mo ang flashlight ko. Minsan nawawala ang kuryente dito sa Daet, lalo na kapag gabi.
flashlight.line_en: Here, take my flashlight. Sometimes we lose power here in Daet, especially at night.

end.speaker: Lola Pacita
end.line: Pahinga ka na. Umulan din kagabi. Maraming lamok, mag-ingat ka.
end.line_en: Rest a little. It rained last night. There are mosquitoes — be careful.
